summary: Redesigned in the FutureForge Studios language. New: Simplified and Advanced view modes; reseller and client accounts with owned resources, quotas and branding; a one-click app installer (WordPress, DokuWiki) that also features Yunori Mail Server. Migrations 0008 and 0009 are additive: 0008 adds users.view_mode, audience and parent_id with defaults plus account_limits, reseller_branding and resource_owners; 0009 adds app_installs. Nothing is dropped.
